Sending a long document? 🔢 Add page numbers to any PDF in seconds.

1. Open pdf.315tools.com and tap Page numbers
2. Pick your PDF
3. Choose the position and style, like 1 / 9
4. Tap Add page numbers and save

Free · No sign-up · Your files never leave your device 🔒
